answer_1.quote: We conduct an empirical evaluation of Tree-PLV across diverse reasoning tasks, focusing on arithmetic reasoning with the GSM8K and MATH datasets, and commonsense reasoning on the CSQA and StrategyQA datasets.

answer_2.quote: Our results indicate substantial performance gains across all datasets. For instance, when compared to the Mistral-7B self-consistency baseline, our method showed the following increases in accuracy: GSM8K (67.55% → 82.79%), MATH (17.00% → 26.80%), CSQA (68.14% → 72.97%), and StrategyQA (82.86% → 83.25%).
